headline: Accenture (ACN) Expands Banking Role With UniCredit And IBM Partnership
summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) has agreed to a new collaboration with UniCredit and IBM to build a next generation banking platform in Europe. The arrangement includes Accenture acquiring a majority stake in a joint venture that will manage a large share of UniCredit’s technology infrastructure. IBM will work on modernizing UniCredit’s technology stack as part of this multi year initiative. headline: Meta Scales Back Wipro Outsourcing Following AI-Led Business Restructuring
summary: Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) has reduced the volume of IT services outsourced to Wipro Ltd (NYSE:WIT) by at least 25% after an artificial intelligence-driven reorganisation that resulted in the closure of its digital marketing division, according to a report from Mint.
